title: Footprints Not Your Own
intro_lines: Fresh prints lead inland from tide line.
They are barefoot, and not yours.

outcomes.text: You find a cache of dried fish and a shell marker.
Prints vanish into mangrove roots; Tide-Puck whines.
A Tideborn scout watches you from the canopy, then melts away.

choices.label: Set a snare on the trail

outcomes.text: A stranger is snared at dawn; he begs for water.
Nothing trips it; prints stop appearing entirely.

history_note: Alexander Selkirk tamed feral cats after rats gnawed his feet, showing how island survivors read tracks and signs to survive.

title: Fire on the Far Beach
intro_lines: A fire burns on the far beach at midnight.
No one should be out there.

outcomes.text: Free pirates arrive by dawn, wary but friendly.
UTC patrol answers instead; you flee into brush.
The fire dies; no one comes. Tide-Puck growls.
By morning only ash and a torn sail scrap remain.
A boat lands at your cove; stores are rifled.

history_note: Pedro Serrano's smoke was ignored by passing ships for fear of the shoals, showing signals can draw the wrong kind of attention.

title: Voices in the Sea Cave
intro_lines: Echoes of speech rise from the sea cave.
The words are not yours.

outcomes.text: A Tideborn shrine yields a shard and old carvings.
Moray eels guard a flooded passage; you retreat bleeding.
The voices were wind through stone; nothing else.

choices.label: Seal the cave mouth with stone

outcomes.text: The echoes stop; a Tideborn scout thanks you later.
Something scratches at the stones all night.

history_note: Tromelin castaways kept one fire alive fifteen years with worn flint, showing how strange sounds and isolation warp perception.

title: Skeleton with a UTC Ledger
intro_lines: Bones lie beneath a UTC coat.
A waterlogged ledger clings to the ribs.

outcomes.text: Names of Tideborn relic sites are listed in code.
A UTC patrol finds you reading; they want it back.
Tide-Puck digs up a hidden key beside the grave.
Nothing but quiet; you feel oddly lighter.

history_note: Bartholomew Roberts's articles punished defrauders with marooning, showing how ledgers and discipline ruled pirate crews.

title: Stores Missing at Dawn
intro_lines: Your stores are light by morning.
Something has been at them.

choices.label: Set a night watch with Tide-Puck

outcomes.text: A monkey troop is caught red-handed; it scatters.
Footprints lead to a stranger's campfire.
Nothing is taken again, but spoilage rises.
The pit floods in rain; salt water ruins stores.

history_note: Feral pigs and monkeys raid camps and steal food and shiny tools, a documented island nuisance.

title: Lantern from a Wreck
intro_lines: A lantern blinks from a half-sunken wreck.
Three short, three long.

outcomes.text: A survivor clings to the hull; you haul him aboard.
Sharks circle; you lose an oar and retreat.
The wreck is empty; only a drowned lantern.
The lantern goes dark; something swims away.
A Tideborn scout surfaces, nods, and vanishes.

history_note: Serrano's smoke drew no rescue because ships feared the shoals, showing how signals at sea carry uncertain risk.

title: Second Set of Prints
intro_lines: Two sets of prints now, side by side.
One is barefoot; one wears boots.

outcomes.text: A UTC deserter hides in a thicket, fevered.
The trail leads to a hidden UTC cache.
The prints loop back to your own camp.
A Tideborn scout leaves a shell gift.
The prints end at a cliff edge; nothing below.

history_note: A deserter told Roberts how HMS Swallow sailed best, showing deserters carry dangerous intelligence.

title: Whispers in the Canopy
intro_lines: Something whispers your name at dusk.
The trees are still.

outcomes.text: A parrot repeats your name; it perches nearby.
Silence, then a stone drops near your head.
Nothing answers; Tide-Puck refuses to move.
You find a hidden trail marker behind a boulder.
You wander in circles until dawn.

history_note: Parrots mimic speech and were sold in havens, a grounded reason voices seem to come from the trees.

title: The Stranger at Your Fire
intro_lines: The snared stranger sits by your fire.
He claims to be a castaway.

choices.label: Feed him and hear his story

outcomes.text: He proves a loyal ally and shares a hidden map.
At dawn your stores are gone; he has vanished.

choices.label: March him to the beach at gunpoint

outcomes.text: He flees into the surf; no harm done.
He panics, stabs you, and escapes into jungle.

history_note: Serrano quarrelled with a second castaway before reconciling, showing survivor trust is a gamble.

title: The Rescued Survivor
intro_lines: The man from the wreck dries by your fire.
He watches your stores closely.

choices.label: Give him a bunk and work

outcomes.text: He repairs your skiff and earns his keep.
He slips away with tools and rum at night.

choices.label: Question him hard about the wreck

outcomes.text: He admits UTC ties; you learn patrol routes.
He clams up and refuses to speak again.

history_note: Pirate articles marooned defrauders with a gun and bottle of water, showing trust among castaways was enforced harshly.

title: The Betrayal Revealed
intro_lines: Tracks lead to a hidden boat.
Your stolen gear is stacked inside.

outcomes.text: You recover everything; he flees into the surf.
He escapes with half; you are left bleeding.

choices.label: Let him go, take the boat

outcomes.text: A sound boat and quiet conscience; tide turns.
The boat leaks; you swim back empty-handed.

history_note: Roberts used a captured master to identify the richest Portuguese ship, showing betrayal and cunning were tools of survival.

title: Salt-Bleached Pages
intro_lines: Tide-Puck sniffs a leather satchel in the wrack.
Pages torn, salt-stained, half legible.
A first mate's hand, not yours.

outcomes.text: A map fragment emerges between the lines; a name you almost know.
The ink runs in the humidity; only one word survives: 'Sovereign'.

choices.label: Trade pages to a passing trader

outcomes.text: Gold changes hands; the trader reads, frowns, says nothing.
He offers a relic shard instead, claims it matches the writing.

history_note: Alexander Selkirk kept a journal and read aloud to preserve his speech during four years of isolation.

title: The Hermit Knows Your Name
intro_lines: A hut of woven fronds, smoke rising.
An old man steps out and greets you by name.
He knew you before you spoke.

outcomes.text: He shows a locket with your face; says the sea owes you a debt.
He laughs, claims it was a lucky guess, and vanishes into brush.
He accepts, then warns of crystals that twist the compass true.
He refuses, eyes wild; something in the jungle watches you both.

history_note: Castaways like Pedro Serrano survived years alone on tiny cays, and a second survivor arriving sparked quarrel then reconciliation.

title: The Stranger's Ledger
intro_lines: The hermit's locket opens to a ledger page.
Names, debts, and a UTC seal pressed in wax.
Your name sits beside a sum unpaid.

outcomes.text: You slip away; Tide-Puck finds a pearl in the sand behind you.
A UTC patrol appears on the ridge; you barely evade them.
He weeps, admits he kept you alive for the UTC bounty.
He tears the page, burns it, and swears to shield you forever.

history_note: Pirate articles allowed marooning with a gun and water for defrauding the company, and deserters traded intelligence for pardons.

title: Ghost Ship on the Reef
intro_lines: Fog lifts; a galleon drifts, sails set.
No crew on deck, lanterns still lit.
Tide-Puck whines and will not board.

outcomes.text: Cabins hold sealed crates; one yields a relic shard and powder.
Below decks, a sound like breathing; you flee empty-handed.
The ship answers with three lantern flashes, then sinks below.
No answer; by dawn only wreckage and gulls remain.

history_note: Condent's Fiery Dragon was scuttled in Sainte-Marie bay as a pardon condition, and ships were deliberately sunk as harbour barriers.

title: Bones of the First Settlers
intro_lines: A cave mouth, walled with coral blocks.
Inside, skeletons in a row, hands bound.
Older than any pirate's bones.

outcomes.text: A carved shell pendant; Tideborn scouts watch from the dark.
Dust rises; you cough blood for a day, but find a bell.
You wall it shut; a quiet settles, and Tide-Puck relaxes.
Something scratches from within all night; sleep is lost.

history_note: On Tromelin, French crew abandoned sixty to eighty Malagasy slaves for fifteen years, and seven women plus a baby were eventually rescued.

title: The Buried Bell
intro_lines: Tide-Puck digs at a dune at midnight.
A bronze bell, green with age, half-buried.
It rings once when you lift it.

outcomes.text: A boat appears offshore; free pirates hail you as kin.
The bell cracks; a headache and a nosebleed follow.

choices.label: Bury it again and mark the spot

outcomes.text: You note the place; Tide-Puck seems relieved.
Come morning, the dune is flat and unmarked.

history_note: Bells and signals were used to summon rescue; castaways like Serrano were ignored by passing ships fearing shoals.

title: Compass Points Wrong
intro_lines: Your compass spins near the crystal vein.
North drifts south, then north again.
The crystals hum in the dark.

outcomes.text: It leads to a hidden cache of shards and powder.
You circle for hours and return to camp exhausted.
You leave a cairn; Tide-Puck sniffs out a pearl nearby.
A crystal shard cuts your hand; the wound stings for days.

history_note: UTC dark-binding crystals enrage the leviathan and distort navigation near their veins.

title: The Crystal Hermit's Warning
intro_lines: The hermit waits by a crystal seam.
He speaks of tides that answer to song.
He asks you to destroy one vein.

choices.label: Smash the vein with a hammer

outcomes.text: The hum stops; a tideborn scout appears, grateful.
The crystal shatters into dust; nothing but a headache.
He sighs, presses a shell into your hand, and fades.
He curses you; crystals hum louder that night.

history_note: Tideborn scouts still watch over ruined arches and relics of their ancient people.

title: Whispers in the Wreck
intro_lines: At night the reef wreck groans.
Voices rise and fall with the swell.
Tide-Puck hides behind your legs.

outcomes.text: A locked chest yields gold and a map fragment.
A shark circles; you surface with nothing but a cut.
You catch a name: 'Selkirk' — then silence.
The voices turn to laughter; you sleep badly.

history_note: Alexander Selkirk ran down feral goats on foot and tamed kid goats for milk and company during his isolation.

title: The Second Castaway
intro_lines: A raft washes in at dawn.
A stranger, half-starved, begs water.
He knows the Sovereign by name.

outcomes.text: He recovers, then steals your compass and flees.
He stays, helps fortify camp, and shares a secret cove.
He curses you from the surf, then drifts off.
He returns that night with pirates; you hold them off.

history_note: Serrano's second castaway arrived and they quarrelled before reconciling, echoing survivor conflict.

title: The Name in the Tide
intro_lines: During the storm, the Sovereign surfaces.
It speaks your name in a voice like surf.
Tide-Puck bows low.

outcomes.text: A relic shard glows; the storm breaks and you gain insight.
The waves surge; camp floods and you barely escape.
The Sovereign passes; the storm dies at dawn.
It circles all night; you do not sleep.

history_note: The Abyssal Sovereign broke both ships in the storm that marooned the player on these shores.
